bullets.text: Agentic AI Revolutionizes Networking - **Infovista** introduces an AI framework for autonomous network operations, enhancing efficiency for telcos.
Remote Fiber Monitoring Gains Traction - Engineers can now detect fiber issues from afar, reducing repair times significantly.
Telia Reports Flat Revenue - Despite stable revenue, **Telia** faces profit declines due to asset retirement obligations.
Openreach Enhances Engineer Safety - New app launched to protect engineers from abuse while working in the field.
Vodafone Partners with Skylo - New satellite tech to enhance IoT connectivity, expanding coverage for customers.
NEC Cuts 5G Power Consumption - New compact amplifier module reduces energy draw in 5G base stations.
Meta and Corning Sign $6bn Deal - Partnership to supply fiber optic cables for AI data centers across the US.
Nokia's AI Infrastructure Strategy - **Nokia** sees growth in fiber demand, despite profit pressures from restructuring.
5G Launches Across North Africa - Libya becomes the last Mediterranean nation to launch 5G services.
Intracom Telecom Expands with Nova - New collaboration to enhance enterprise connectivity using 5G mmWave technology.
